caption: Harbour, Doesburg
composition: IJssel quay, gabled houses, and the Martinikerk tower · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the IJssel quay at Doesburg the dark river fills the foreground, gabled houses line the bank, and the tall brick tower of the Grote of Martinikerk rises over the roofs. The sky is clear, about 9.5°C, with almost no wind, about 1.8 km/h. Sunset was 19:24. The quay is quiet. No shop lettering is treated as real signage.
